title: Architecture Studio Source Images
description: sources/sources.json: the images the user supplied, with their identity, calibration, and placement. Written only by scripts/import-image.mjs. It is authoritative for image scale and placement; brief.json sources[] is the intake summary. See references/image-intake.md and coordinate-contract.md, Source Images.

pixel.description: Canonical pixel coordinates: after EXIF orientation, origin at the top-left corner of the top-left pixel, x right, y down, continuous (the centre of pixel (i, j) is (i + 0.5, j + 0.5)).

region.description: A pixel rectangle that a calibration applies to, for sheets that mix views at different scales.

contentHash.description: Hash of the file bytes at import. A file that no longer matches is stale: nothing measures or draws from it until it is re-imported with add --replace.

revision.description: Increments each time the file is replaced. Replacing clears calibrations, north, references, areas, and placement.

calibrationRevision.description: Increments whenever calibrations or the placement change (a new or recomputed placement transform). Placements, pasted viewer payloads, and evidence references record the value they were made against.

exifOrientation.description: The JPEG EXIF orientation tag (1 when absent). pixels are already oriented.

references.description: Labelled points the user or agent marked on the image, such as a house corner, for later image-to-model pairs.

areas.description: Labelled outlines the user drew on the image, such as a garden bed. Their sizes are not stored: list computes them from the current scale. They never set property lines or setbacks.

legacyCalibration.description: A calibration copied from brief.json sources[] that has no pixel points yet. The agent must locate it on the image and record a real calibration.

deg.description: Clockwise degrees from image-up to true north, the same convention as project.coordinates.trueNorthDeg.

source.description: assumed (for example a north-up satellite image) must also be listed as an assumption.

method.description: printed-dimension, scale-bar, stated-scale, and map-metadata are the automatic fallbacks. manual comes from the viewer; control-points from image-to-model pairs. known-object needs acceptedByUser.

estimated.description: true when the agent estimated the endpoint pixels by reading the image.

relativeUncertainty.description: About 2 x uncertaintyPx / baselinePx for two-point methods; stated by the user or 0.02 for stated-scale and map-metadata.

provenance.description: Where the distance came from, for example: printed 48'-0" dimension along the north wall.

acceptedByUser.description: Required true for known-object before it counts.

placement.description: Where the image sits in model coordinates. model = [a c e; b d f] x [px; py; 1]. It is a similarity transform with a y flip (image y runs down, model y up), so a*d - b*c < 0.

view.description: site, or the id of the level whose plan the image underlays.

usesNorth.description: true when the rotation came from north (one pair) rather than from fitting two or more pairs.

trueNorthDeg.description: The model's project.coordinates.trueNorthDeg a north-derived placement used. The placement is stale when the model's value differs.

rotationDeg.description: Counter-clockwise rotation from the y-flipped image to model axes.

calibrationRevision.description: The source's calibrationRevision after this placement was made; the source bumps it on every calibration or placement change.
